FBI agent Neville Flynn (Samuel L. Jackson) boards a flight from Hawaii to Los Angeles, escorting a witness to trial. An on-board assassin releases a crate of deadly serpents in an attempt to kill the witness. Flynn and a host of frightened passengers and crew must band together to survive the slithery threat.

When timid bank clerk Stanley Ipkiss (Jim Carrey) discovers a magical mask containing the spirit of the Norse god Loki, his entire life changes. While wearing the mask, Ipkiss becomes a supernatural playboy exuding charm and confidence which allows him to catch the eye of local nightclub singer Tina Carlyle (Cameron Diaz). Unfortunately, under the mask's influence, Ipkiss also robs a bank, which angers junior crime lord Dorian Tyrell (Peter Greene), whose goons get blamed for the heist.

After arriving safely home from their unprecedented victory in the 74th Annual Hunger Games, Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) and Peeta Mellark (Josh Hutcherson) discover that they must do a quick turnaround and begin a Victors Tour. As she and Peeta travel throughout the districts, Katniss senses a rebellion is stirring. However, President Snow (Donald Sutherland) proves that he is still very much in control when word comes of a cruel change in the rules for the upcoming 75th Hunger Games.

Following her rescue from the devastating Quarter Quell, Katniss (Jennifer Lawrence) awakes in the complex beneath the supposedly destroyed District 13. Her home, District 12, has been reduced to rubble, and Peeta Mellark (Josh Hutcherson) is now the brainwashed captive of President Snow (Donald Sutherland). At the same time, Katniss also learns about a secret rebellion spreading throughout all of Panem -- a rebellion that will place her at the center of a plot to turn the tables on Snow.

Realizing the stakes are no longer just for survival, Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) teams up with her closest friends, including Peeta (Josh Hutcherson), Gale (Liam Hemsworth) and Finnick for the ultimate mission. Together, they leave District 13 to liberate the citizens of war-torn Panem and assassinate President Snow, who's obsessed with destroying Katniss. What lies ahead are mortal traps, dangerous enemies and moral choices that will ultimately determine the future of millions.

Her home, District 12, has been reduced to rubble, and Peeta Mellark (Josh Hutcherson) is now the brainwashed captive of President Snow (Donald Sutherland). At the same time, Katniss also learns about a secret rebellion spreading throughout all of Panem -- a rebellion that will place her at the center of a plot to turn the tables on Snow.

Realizing the stakes are no longer just for survival, Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) teams up with her closest friends, including Peeta (Josh Hutcherson), Gale (Liam Hemsworth) and Finnick for the ultimate mission. Together, they leave District 13 to liberate the citizens of war-torn Panem and assassinate President Snow, who's obsessed with destroying Katniss. What lies ahead are mortal traps, dangerous enemies and moral choices that will ultimately determine the future of millions.
Scientific research leads to a billionaire's space station as Homebase pieces the puzzle together.

FBI agent Neville Flynn (Samuel L. Jackson) boards a flight from Hawaii to Los Angeles, escorting a witness to trial. An on-board assassin releases a crate of deadly serpents in an attempt to kill the witness. Flynn and a host of frightened passengers and crew must band together to survive the slithery threat.

It's been 40 years since Laurie Strode survived a vicious attack from crazed killer Michael Myers on Halloween night. Locked up in an institution, Myers manages to escape when his bus transfer goes horribly wrong. Laurie now faces a terrifying showdown when the masked madman returns to Haddonfield, Ill. -- but this time, she's ready for him.
After a lifetime on Fleet Street, journalist Kevin O'Sullivan tackles some of the biggest stories of the day and champions free speech while leading the culture war against 'woke'.
Westminster insider, author and broadcast presenter Peter Cardwell scours all the latest news from inside and around Parliament, featuring exclusive interviews with political heavyweights.

p.d: Kevin O'Sullivan wraps up another mad, mad week in the world of news. Expect bold opinions from TV's most outspoken host.

All the best bits from your favourite presenters on TALK.

Jamie returns to cooking the food he loves the most, getting right to heart of the Italian kitchen.
Jamie heads for one of the hottest food destinations in Italy, making hand-crafted pasta, a special seafood stew, and the region's answer to paella.
Jamie visits the pizza capital of Italy to learn recipes from the locals and tries acquapazza, fish poached in crazy water.
Jamie visits Basilicata in search of some old school Italian recipes and meets a family of shepherds and an 89-year-old macaroni master.

Joey seeks forgiveness from Ross, while Rachel tries to quell Emma's incessant crying.
Emma's pediatrician drops her as a patient because of Rachel's constant calls.

Un aristócrata oficial romano se gana el desprecio de Nerón cuando se enamora de una joven cristiana.
Durante la Guerra Civil, una hermosa mujer del Sur está determinada a conquistar al hombre de su elección.

Lola, una adolescente de 16 años, quiere irse de viaje, pero su familia se opone pues están absorbidos por el trastorno mental de su hermana mayor. La inestabilidad y el desgaste en el vínculo con su familia hacen que Lola busque nuevas experiencias.
La búsqueda de una mujer por el amor prueba ser su ruina. Basada en la novela por Gustave Flaubert.

El último curso en la escuela secundaria Suzuran se acerca a su fin para Genji y sus compañeros. Aun así, los problemas para los Cuervos no han hecho más que empezar. Genji sigue obsesionado con vencer a Rindaman, aunque todos sus intentos terminen en derrota, para alegría del grupo de Serizawa.
Ganadora del Óscar por sus efectos especiales. El viajero del tiempo de H.G. Wells visita diversas civilizaciones.

Matías pone el cuerpo en sus negocios por primera vez y descubre en carne propia las desventajas de hacerlo, pero no teme tomar represalias. Quinteros ejerce presión y no suelta sospechas. Lourdes consigue un nuevo empleo y se acerca más a Matías.

Matías urde un plan para sobreponerse a sus aprietos mientras profundiza su relación de negocios con el pastor Ospina. El fiscal Quinteros, sin perderle los pasos, encuentra una poderosa aliada para acorralarlo. Lourdes tiene una propuesta atípica.
La policía de Hong Kong busca a una pandilla liderada por un líder conocido como Painter. En un esfuerzo por encontrar la verdadera identidad de Painter, la policía recluta al artista Lee Man.
Durante un verano en Los Ángeles, la relación larga de Owen y Hallie podría terminarse. Al mismo tiempo que su relación llega a un punto de no retorno, Matt y Willa comienzan su propio romance.

Steven Kenet (Robert Taylor) has been blacking out, which is particularly problematic because he has been convicted of a crime he thinks he did not commit -- murdering his wife. Afraid that brain surgery will allow his accusers to decree him insane, Kenet instead is sent to a mental hospital. At the hospital, Dr. Ann Lorrison (Audrey Totter) falls for Kenet. But after initially believing his story, she starts to doubt whether her patient, the man she loves, is innocent after all.

During her engagement party, Joan Ellis (Phyllis Thaxter) hears the voice of another personality called Karen within her. Karen forces Joan to leave her fiancé, Bob Arnold (Henry H. Daniels Jr.), and move to New York. There she meets lawyer Eric Russell (Stephen McNally), whom she falls for, but again Karen compels her to flee. When she returns to Bob, Karen takes control and murders him. Joan's fate then hinges upon Dr. Bergson (Edmund Gwenn) being able to uncover her illness.
When a psychoanalyst's new patient turns out to be the spitting image of him, it soon becomes difficult to determine who is the doctor and who is the patient.

When psychiatrist Hunt Bailey (George Brent) encounters elderly Clarissa "Cissie" Bedereaux (Olive Blakeney) during a violent storm in 1903, his unusual relationship with the strange Bedereaux family begins. Suspicious of Cissie's sudden death and bewitched by a painting he sees of Allida (Hedy Lamarr), the gorgeous but troubled wife of Nick Bedereaux (Paul Lukas), Hunt sets out to discover if Allida is really insane, as her husband claims -- or if Nick is the disturbed one.

Geoffrey Carroll (Humphrey Bogart) is a married artist who meets the lovely Sally Morton (Barbara Stanwyck) while on vacation. Hiding his marital status from Sally, Geoffrey goes on to paint a foreboding portrait of his spouse and then kills her by gradually slipping her poison. Before long, Geoffrey woos and marries Sally, but eventually he begins an eerie painting of her, as his attention shifts to the beautiful Cecily Latham (Alexis Smith). Will the deranged Geoffrey murder again?

While working at a hospital, Dr. Jeff Cameron (Robert Mitchum) finds himself falling in love with Margo (Faith Domergue), an emotionally unstable woman who was hospitalized after a suicide attempt. Unsound and deceitful, Margo also has a husband (Claude Rains) of whom Cameron is unaware. When the two men find out about one another, a fight ensues that leads to the death of the husband -- though Cameron cannot recall killing him. Now, at Margo's insistence, Cameron must flee to Mexico with her.

After getting a glimpse of the conditions at the St. Mary's of Bethlehem Asylum, known as "Bedlam," Nell Bowen (Anna Lee) is concerned that the patients are being mistreated. When she seeks to better the situation, the head of St. Mary's, George Sims (Boris Karloff), uses his political savvy to have Nell committed. Being within St. Mary's does not deter Nell, however, and she starts to turn the patients against Sims in a bid to violently oust him from power.

While Hollywood proves too cautious to deal with Adolph Hitler's rise to power in the 1930s, Charlie Chaplin is the exception, crafting "The Great Dictator" as a direct and utterly satirical response to the growing threat of the Third Reich. Using behind-the-scenes film footage rescued from Chaplin's Swiss villa, Kevin Brownlow's documentary explores this unique confrontation between one of the 20th century's most beloved entertainers and its most notorious dictator.

After dedicated service in the Great War, a Jewish barber (Charles Chaplin) spends years in an army hospital recovering from his wounds, unaware of the simultaneous rise of fascist dictator Adenoid Hynkel (also Chaplin) and his anti-Semitic policies. When the barber, who bears a remarkable resemblance to Hynkel, returns to his quiet neighborhood, he is stunned by the brutal changes and recklessly joins a beautiful girl (Paulette Goddard) and her neighbors in rebelling.

p.t: To Be or Not to Be
p.d: Acting couple Joseph (Jack Benny) and Maria Tura (Carole Lombard) are managing a theatrical troupe when the Nazis invade Poland. Maria is having an affair with Lieutenant Sobinski (Robert Stack), who suspects Professor Siletsky (Stanley Ridges) is a Nazi spy. With Siletsky in possession of a list of members of the Polish resistance, the Turas' company takes action. Using their skill for impersonation, Joseph and company must confuse the Nazis and stop Siletsky from handing over the list.

Down-and-out producer Max Bialystock (Zero Mostel), who was once the toast of Broadway, trades sexual favors with old ladies for cash contributions. Max's new accountant Leo Bloom (Gene Wilder), offhandedly muses that if Max found investors for a new production that turned into a flop, he could legally keep all the extra money. The duo begins to put together the worst play possible, titled "Springtime for Hitler", with a terrible director and a hippie-freak star.

In the beginning stages of World War II, burlesque dancer Katherine O'Hara (Ginger Rogers) ignores the effects of the war and focuses on climbing the social ladder. When she marries the influential Baron Franz Von Luber (Walter Slezak), Katherine seemingly has it made, but Von Luber might not be the man she thinks. Already suspecting Von Luber's ties to Nazism, foreign correspondent Patrick O'Toole (Cary Grant) must convince Katherine to turn spy on her husband to help the Allies' war effort.

El marido de Shannon la quiere tal y como es, pero eso quizás no es de ayuda, ya que ella pesa casi 320 kilogramos y está postrada en la cama. El Dr. Now sabe que no es fácil romper un ciclo tóxico de sobrealimentación.

En la selva maya encantada, una herida dolorosa pone a prueba la determinación de los sobrevivientes Leah y César, que enfrentan depredadores hambrientos, humedad sofocante, lluvias torrenciales, insectos implacables y frutas venenosas.

Una persona que sobrevivió a ataques de tiburones, osos y serpientes de cascabel forma equipo con Brooke, la esposa de Matt Wright. En África, los concursantes se enfrentan a hienas y leones que buscan alimentos.

Los incendios forestales se están convirtiendo en megaincendios que devastan zonas pobladas y causan trágicas pérdidas de vidas, como ocurrió con el incendio de Yarnell Hill y el de Maui en Lahaina, Hawái. Los expertos investigan la ciencia y las causas.

Los volcanes entran en erupción a diario en todo el mundo y tienen un enorme potencial destructivo. Imágenes impactantes y relatos de supervivencia revelan su poder, desde el monte Santa Helena en 1980 hasta la erupción del Volcán de Fuego en 2018.

La temporada de huracanes, de junio a noviembre, mantiene a millones entre la expectación y el miedo. Expertos exploran su formación, su creciente frecuencia e intensidad y la ciencia detrás de cómo sobrevivir.

En Florida, la policía que rastrea a los ladrones de autos se encuentra persiguiendo a dos sospechosos. Un allanamiento en Michigan da un giro mortal cuando el sospechoso toma como rehenes a los propietarios y a su hijo y abre fuego.
En Nuevo México, una persecución acaba con graves consecuencias para un teniente. Mientras tanto en California, agentes combaten un incendio vehicular para salvar a un conductor atrapado.

En Arizona, un policía y un bombero responden a una grave colisión vehicular. En Florida, la policía persigue a un sospechoso que elige una ruta de escape inesperada, y en Georgia, los oficiales buscan a un hombre armado escondido en el bosque.
Un matrimonio de Idaho se enfrenta a la peligrosa jungla filipina. Lluvias torrenciales, insectos implacables y jabalíes letales ponen a prueba sus habilidades de supervivencia y su relación.

Cuando las renovaciones recientes provocan una actividad fantasmal en el manicomio Wildwood del norte de Nueva York, Nick Groff y Katrina Weidman pasan 72 horas intentando determinar qué espíritus han vuelto inhabitable el lugar.

Los investigadores paranormales, Nick Groff y Katrina Weidman, pasan 72 horas confinados en la histórica destilería Jim Beam, cuyos empleados afirman que hay espíritus encerrados dentro de los enormes depósitos de la propiedad.

Tras alcanzar categoría 5, el huracán Ian golpea la costa de Florida con vientos y mareas que arrasan viviendas de todo tipo. Las cámaras captan a residentes que enfrentan con desesperación una de las tormentas más fuertes que han tocado tierra en EE. UU.

Las cámaras capturan el desastre que se desarrolla mientras un poderoso tornado EF-4 devasta Mayfield, arrasando el juzgado, la comisaría y la cárcel, donde los agentes se apresuran a rescatar a los reclusos atrapados mientras evitan que se fuguen.

Equipos de expertos cazadores de tormentas y observadores meteorológicos certificados lo arriesgan todo para adentrarse en el Corredor de Tornados en Estados Unidos y graban ellos mismos sus encuentros con la naturaleza en su forma más extrema, advierten a las personas que se encuentran en peligro, ayudando a salvar vidas cuando se produce una catástrofe.

Una historia de romance y misterio en la que únicamente el amor es sinónimo de salvación.

The true story of Molly Bloom, a beautiful, young, Olympic-class skier who ran the world's most exclusive high-stakes poker game for a decade before being arrested in the middle of the night by 17 FBI agents wielding automatic weapons. Her players included Hollywood royalty, sports stars, business titans and finally, unbeknown to her, the Russian mob. Her only ally was her criminal defense lawyer Charlie Jaffey, who learned there was much more to Molly than the tabloids led people to believe.

Douglas Quaid is a bored construction worker in the year 2084 who dreams of visiting colonized Mars. He visits "Rekall," a company that plants false memories into people's brains, in order to experience the thrill of Mars without having to travel there. But something goes wrong during the procedure; Quaid discovers that his entire life is actually a false memory and that the people who implanted it in his head now want him dead.

An aging hit man must train a young prodigy when his employer moves to replace the old guard. However, when they learn they're being betrayed, the unlikely pair turns into a lethal team -- with their double-crossing bosses in their sights.

Under-appreciated and overburdened moms Amy, Kiki and Carla rebel against the challenges and expectations of the Super Bowl for moms: Christmas. As if creating the perfect holiday for their families isn't hard enough, they'll have to do it while hosting and entertaining their own respective mothers when they come to visit.

When the CEO (Jennifer Aniston) tries to close her hard-partying brother's (T.J. Miller) branch, he and his chief technical officer (Jason Bateman) must rally their co-workers and host an epic office Christmas party in an effort to impress a potential client and close a sale that will save their jobs.

p.t: Jay and Silent Bob Strike Back
p.d: When Jay and Silent Bob learn that a Bluntman and Chronic movie is being made featuring their comic book counterparts, they drool at the thought of fat movie checks rolling in. But when the pair find that there won't be any royalties coming their way, they set out to sabotage the flick at all costs.

In this comedic documentary, Johnny Knoxville heads a crew of stuntmen, skateboarders and all-around lunatics as they prank, embarrass and torture each other in the name of fun. The antics range from childlike -- the boys don panda suits for a romp through Tokyo -- to grotesque and life-threatening. A golf cart demolition derby turns downright dangerous. Live gators nearly chomp maniac Steve-O. Filmmaker Spike Jonze and Knoxville, in heavy makeup, test the public's patience for the elderly.

Daredevils (Johnny Knoxville, Bam Margera, Steve-O) go for the gross-out when they subject an unsuspecting public to more outrageous stunts and practical jokes. Danger, pain and bodily fluids are in plentiful supply as the gang tries to up the ante in the continuous quest to shock and annoy.

Johnny Knoxville, Bam Margera, Steve-O, Wee Man and the rest of their fearless and foolhardy friends take part in another round of outrageous pranks and stunts. In addition to standing in the path of a charging bull, launching themselves into the air and crashing through various objects, the guys perform in segments such as "Sweatsuit Cocktail," "Beehive Tetherball" and "Lamborghini Tooth Pull."

Irascible Irving Zisman and his young and impressionable grandson, Billy, set out on a road trip across America. Hidden cameras capture their insane and shocking encounters with a diverse set of unsuspecting citizens, including male strippers, disgruntled contestants (and their mothers) from a children's beauty pageant, mourners at a funeral home, patrons at a biker bar and more. Based on the "Jackass" TV series.

Serving a life sentence alone on a distant planet, an aging convict must confront his past when a new prisoner arrives and forces him to remember his life on Earth.

Ever since his father died, young Kale (Shia LaBeouf) has become increasingly sullen and withdrawn, until he finds himself under house arrest. With cabin fever setting in, he turns his attention to spying on his neighbors, becoming increasingly suspicious that one of them is a serial killer. However, he wonders if he is right, or if his overactive imagination is getting the better of him.
Long-buried secrets threaten to tear a couple apart.

David (Woody Harrelson) and Diana Murphy (Demi Moore) are a loving couple with a bright future. David is a talented architect; Diana is a top-notch real estate agent. But when the recession hits, their finances take a nosedive. In a last-ditch effort to save their dream home, they head to Las Vegas to win their mortgage money gambling. After they lose everything, a mysterious billionaire (Robert Redford) offers the solution to their money problems: $1 million -- if he can sleep with Diana.
A woman decides to run away to the Oregon coast with her boyfriend when he inherits a family beach house.

With cabin fever setting in, he turns his attention to spying on his neighbors, becoming increasingly suspicious that one of them is a serial killer. However, he wonders if he is right, or if his overactive imagination is getting the better of him.

Defense attorney Martin Vail takes on jobs for money and prestige rather than any sense of the greater good. His latest case involves an altar boy, accused of brutally murdering the archbishop of Chicago. Vail finds himself up against his ex-pupil and ex-lover, but as the case progresses and the Church's dark secrets are revealed, Vail finds that what appeared a simple case takes on a darker, more dangerous aspect.

After building an empire with bootleg alcohol, legendary crime boss Al Capone (Robert De Niro) rules Chicago with an iron fist. Though Prohibition agent Eliot Ness (Kevin Costner) attempts to take Capone down, even his best efforts fail due to widespread corruption within the Windy City's police force. Recruiting an elite group of lawmen who won't be swayed by bribes or fear, including Irish-American cop Jim Malone (Sean Connery), Ness renews his determination to bring Capone to justice.

The sweeping expanses of the Sahara are the setting for a passionate love affair in this adaptation of Michael Ondaatje's novel. A badly burned man, Laszlo de Almasy (Ralph Fiennes), is tended to by a nurse, Hana (Juliette Binoche), in an Italian monastery near the end of World War II. His past is revealed through flashbacks involving a married Englishwoman (Kristin Scott Thomas) and his work mapping the African landscape. Hana learns to heal her own scars as she helps the dying man.

p.t: Todo en 90 días: Antes del viaje
p.d: Gino y Jasmine buscan ayuda profesional. Amanda se sorprende porque Razvan quiere hijos. Statler y Dempsey pasan la noche juntas. Sheila se siente amenazada. Violet se aleja de Riley. A Meisha le preocupa equivocarse sobre Nicola.

p.t: Todo en 90 días: Antes del viaje
p.d: David y Sheila enfrentan una tragedia inesperada. Gino y Jasmine intentan retomar el rumbo. A Cleo le preocupa que el autismo afecte su relación. Riley y Violet se niegan a hablar. Dempsey descubre algo impactante sobre Statler.
Una novia que siempre ha sido la dama de honor; una segunda boda perfecta; una novia compró su vestido hace cuatro años.

El quejoso séquito de la novia Francesa causa más problemas que soluciones aporta. Brittany desea un vestido no tradicional, pero su madre lo desaprueba. Samantha quiere un vestido con la parte superior absolutamente transparente.

Amy lucha por definir su relación con Chris; Zach se da cuenta de que necesita un nuevo trabajo para mantener a su familia, pero duda cuando Matt le ofrece una solución; Jeremy y Audrey se están quedando sin tiempo para tomar una decisión.

La opinión de Zach y Tori de su familia cambia por una tragedia repentina y noticias inesperadas; Jeremy y Audrey deciden dónde quieren criar a su familia; Amy se emociona al dar su primer paso hacia la independencia financiera de la granja.

Es la primera Navidad del bebé Leighton y los Johnston hacen todo lo posible para que sea especial. Anna y su amiga Autumn contemplan la posibilidad de tener una cita doble mientras Trent y Amber discuten un plan para el cuidado de los padres de él.
Jewel se va a casar con Nick, pero Josiah quiere causar problemas en la ceremonia. La hermana de Nuckie organiza una fiesta con regalos antes de la boda, pero acuden personas no invitadas.

Kara y Guillermo se casan. La incertidumbre de los tailandeses se agudiza en Massachusetts. Emily descubre que Kobe está mirando el futuro de manera diferente. Shaeeda recibe un consejo de la madre de Bilal.
El nuevo socio de Amber le causa problemas económicos. Mark quiere reavivar un romance después de muchos años. Martine espera que su novio DJ sea la persona adecuada.

Daniel lanza una bomba sobre Amber después de una noche increíble juntos. Aryanna viaja a Jamaica y está ansiosa por ver a Sherlon. Mark y Key tienen un encuentro apasionado y recuerdan los viejos tiempos.
Baylen va a Texas para una convención sobre el Tourette, pero sus tics podrían opacar su gran momento. Un médico sugiere un tratamiento radical, pero es demasiado para Baylen.

Surgen dudas sobre la capacidad de Baylen para vivir sola luego de sufrir un aterrador ataque de tics. Baylen y Colin deciden dar un gran paso en su relación, pero la emoción dura poco cuando le dan la noticia a la familia.

Whitney invierte mucho dinero en la producción de un video de ejercicios. Glenn y Babs sorprenden a Whitney en el set justo cuando escucha que Buddy, su protagonista, se retiró. Glenn puede ser la única persona que puede salvar el día.

Con el vídeo musical terminado y Babs prosperando en Abbotswood, Whitney, su hermano y sus amigos por fin pueden irse de vacaciones a Santa Lucía. Whitney revela su relación abierta y todos se preguntan si Lennie hará algo al respecto.

p.t: Extreme Makeover: Home Edition Latin America
p.d: Un programa basado en el original Extreme Makeover de EE. UU., en donde un equipo de diseñadores reconstruyen y embellecen la casa de gente necesitada en un tiempo muy corto.
Tres miembros de la Brigada de Homicidios de Austria comparten sus labores policiales con Rex, un pastor alemán entrenado como perro policía.
La mejor información de deportiva de Panamá y el mundo.

Una nueva toma en la serie clásica de 1970 del mismo nombre, trae a tres bellezas frescas para resolver los casos de difícil millonario Charlie Townsend. La princesa de Park Avenue, que se convirtió en ladrón Abby (Rachael Taylor), la desacreditada policía de Miami Kate (Annie Ilonzeh) y la misteriosa corredora de la calle Eva (Minka Kelly) forman una estrecha amistad, ya que tienen una segunda oportunidad en la vida como detectives en la soleada Miami. Aunque son desconocidos cuando se juntan, una cosa es cierta: que siempre se cubrirán las espaldas unas a otras. Drew Barrymore, quien co-protagonizó la película "Los ángeles de Charlie", es la productora ejecutiva de la serie.
Tres miembros de la Brigada de Homicidios de Austria comparten sus labores policiales con Rex, un pastor alemán entrenado como perro policía.

Un teniente de policía se debate entre la fidelidad al cuerpo y la vinculación que mantiene con los amigos junto a los que creció en las calles más duras de Los Ángeles, para quienes, a menudo, la policía es el enemigo.
Los accidentes catastróficos en la historia de la aviación son reproducidos meticulosamente para determinar si estos desastres pudieron haber sido prevenidos.

La Unidad de Inteligencia del Departamento de Policía de Chicago, liderada por el sargento Hank Voight, se ocupa de investigar los delitos más graves. En la búsqueda de la verdad, Voight deberá adaptarse a un sistema penal en constante cambio.

NCIS es la sigla de Servicio Naval de Investigaciones Criminales. La serie narra las operaciones de un equipo élite de agentes especiales cuya misión es la de investigar cualquier crimen que tenga cualquier evidencia conectada a la marina y a su personal, sin tener en cuenta su posición o rango.

After an immigration agent is fatally shot at a hockey game, the team attempts to find the shooter, who they believe may also be targeting Congressman Curtis Grange, who was at the same game.

When a young couple is found murdered in a New York City park after returning from a vacation, the team searches for a suspect linked to the drug trade; Scola turns over a new leaf when it comes to his relationships.
OA is forced to confront one of his biggest fears when the team discovers that deadly sarin gas may have been sold to terrorists.
When the team is called to the scene of a murder, it quickly suspects political motivation; Maggie contemplates a decision that could affect her entire career.

With the imminent destruction of Krypton, their home planet, Jor-El (Russell Crowe) and his wife seek to preserve their race by sending their infant son to Earth. The child's spacecraft lands at the farm of Jonathan (Kevin Costner) and Martha (Diane Lane) Kent, who name him Clark and raise him as their own son. Though his extraordinary abilities have led to the adult Clark (Henry Cavill) living on the fringe of society, he finds he must become a hero to save those he loves from a dire threat.

Raised by his overprotective mother, Helen, Bobby Boucher Jr. is the water boy for a successful college football team coached by Red Beaulieu. When Beaulieu fires Bobby, he takes up the same position for a losing rival team, led by despairing Coach Klein. After witnessing Bobby beat up a player who teased him too much, Klein adds him to the roster as a linebacker. Soon, Klein's players are championship contenders.
From Grand Casino Arena in St. Paul, Minn.
An ex-🥊 [UFC] UFC fighter ends up working at a rowdy bar in the Florida Keys.
Jess LaCroix and his team come to help OA find a fugitive LaCroix arrested years ago after a bus with 26 students goes missing, and he's the main suspect.

The team investigates a drug deal gone bad after the body of a college student is found; Detective Hailey Upton temporarily joins the team and finds her investigative methods clash with the Bureau's more buttoned-up environment.

The team welcomes a new member, Special Agent Tiffany Wallace, as they search for killers who orchestrated a mass shooting at a media company; OA's personal connection with the case threatens to cloud his judgment.
La ambiciosa Cenicienta recibe ayuda mágica para hacer realidad sus sueños y ganarse la vida vendiendo sus vestidos exclusivos.

Un superhéroe bastante impopular debido a su comportamiento y sus adicciones provoca enormes daños colaterales con cada movimiento que realiza, hasta que recibe ayuda profesional para cambiar su imagen pública.

p.t: Harry Potter y la piedra filosofal
p.d: Durante su primer año en la escuela de magia y hechicería de Hogwarts, Harry Potter descubre que un malévolo y poderoso mago llamado Voldemort está en busca de una piedra filosofal que alarga la vida de quien la posee.

p.t: Harry Potter y la cámara secreta
p.d: Terminado el verano, Harry no ve la hora de abandonar la casa de sus odiosos tíos. Inesperadamente, se presenta en su dormitorio Dobby, un elfo doméstico, que le anuncia que correrá un gran peligro si vuelve a Hogwarts.

Un ogro llamado Shrek vive en su pantano, pero su preciada soledad se ve súbitamente interrumpida por la invasión de los ruidosos personajes de los cuentos de hadas. Todos fueron expulsados de sus reinos por el malvado Lord Farquaad. Decidido a salvar su hogar, Shrek hace un trato con Farquaad y se prepara para rescatar a la princesa Fiona, quien será la esposa de Farquaad.

Los padres de la princesa y reyes de Muy, Muy Lejano invitan a cenar Shrek y Fiona, pero el rey Harold descubre que su yerno es un ogro y acude al Hada Madrina para alejar a Shrek de Fiona y lograr que se case con el guapo Príncipe Encantador.
Shrek y sus amigos van en busca del verdadero heredero de la Tierra Muy Muy Lejana, mientras la Princesa Fiona intenta evitar que el Príncipe Encantador ocupe el trono.

Instalado en su vida matrimonial y totalmente domesticado, Shrek empieza a extrañar los días en los que él se sentía como un verdadero ogro. Engañado para firmar un contrato con el tortuoso Rumpelstiltskin, él se encuentra a sí mismo en una versión alterna de Muy Muy Lejano, donde los ogros son cazados, Rumpelstiltskin manda, y él y Fiona nunca se conocieron. Shrek debe hallar la forma de cancelar el contrato para restaurar su mundo y reclamar su amor verdadero.

El señor Smith, un hombre duro y amargado, acepta proteger a un bebé al que ha ayudado a nacer en medio de un tiroteo. Él no sabe que el niño es el objetivo de una extraña banda de criminales que tiene la misión de asesinarlo.

Mickey Pearson, un estadounidense expatriado en Londres, se ha hecho rico con el negocio de la marihuana. Sin embargo, cuando se difunde el rumor de que va a vender su imperio, varios criminales se disputan la oportunidad que se les presenta.

Cuando un agente del IRS es asesinado intentando recuperar un yate, y un colega también es atacado, el equipo de CSI busca a los responsables por una potencial serie de asesinatos debido al pago de impuestos.
Horacio debe proteger a Marisol cuando su vida es amenazada después de atestiguar un robo.
Un caso difícil que involucra el posible secuestro de un infante fuerza al equipo a examinar la evidencia que apunta a una conclusión inimaginable.
El equipo investiga a un asesino que mató a una mujer en su casa, pero surgen evidencias que señalan como sospechoso a Nick Stokes.
El equipo investiga la muerte a puñaladas de un aficionado al cine; un chico de 15 años recibe un disparo y es asesinado en un depósito abandonado.
El equipo investiga el incendio de una casa que toma la vida de una joven; un jugador resulta muerto con una teja "S" en la garganta.

p.t: Harry Potter y la cámara secreta
p.d: Terminado el verano, Harry no ve la hora de abandonar la casa de sus odiosos tíos. Inesperadamente, se presenta en su dormitorio Dobby, un elfo doméstico, que le anuncia que correrá un gran peligro si vuelve a Hogwarts.

Un ogro llamado Shrek vive en su pantano, pero su preciada soledad se ve súbitamente interrumpida por la invasión de los ruidosos personajes de los cuentos de hadas. Todos fueron expulsados de sus reinos por el malvado Lord Farquaad. Decidido a salvar su hogar, Shrek hace un trato con Farquaad y se prepara para rescatar a la princesa Fiona, quien será la esposa de Farquaad.

Los padres de la princesa y reyes de Muy, Muy Lejano invitan a cenar Shrek y Fiona, pero el rey Harold descubre que su yerno es un ogro y acude al Hada Madrina para alejar a Shrek de Fiona y lograr que se case con el guapo Príncipe Encantador.
Shrek y sus amigos van en busca del verdadero heredero de la Tierra Muy Muy Lejana, mientras la Princesa Fiona intenta evitar que el Príncipe Encantador ocupe el trono.

Instalado en su vida matrimonial y totalmente domesticado, Shrek empieza a extrañar los días en los que él se sentía como un verdadero ogro. Engañado para firmar un contrato con el tortuoso Rumpelstiltskin, él se encuentra a sí mismo en una versión alterna de Muy Muy Lejano, donde los ogros son cazados, Rumpelstiltskin manda, y él y Fiona nunca se conocieron. Shrek debe hallar la forma de cancelar el contrato para restaurar su mundo y reclamar su amor verdadero.

El señor Smith, un hombre duro y amargado, acepta proteger a un bebé al que ha ayudado a nacer en medio de un tiroteo. Él no sabe que el niño es el objetivo de una extraña banda de criminales que tiene la misión de asesinarlo.

Mickey Pearson, un estadounidense expatriado en Londres, se ha hecho rico con el negocio de la marihuana. Sin embargo, cuando se difunde el rumor de que va a vender su imperio, varios criminales se disputan la oportunidad que se les presenta.

A scruffy superhero named Hancock (Will Smith) protects the citizens of Los Angeles but leaves horrendous collateral damage in the wake of every well-intentioned feat. That's OK with Hancock; he doesn't care what people think and is just as likely to be found dozing on a park bench as saving a damsel in distress. However, after saving the life of a PR executive (Jason Bateman) and meeting the man's beautiful wife (Charlize Theron), he realizes that he may have a sensitive side after all.

p.t: Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone: Extended Version
p.d: Adaptation of the first of J.K. Rowling's popular children's novels about Harry Potter, a boy who learns on his eleventh birthday that he is the orphaned son of two powerful wizards and possesses unique magical powers of his own. He is summoned from his life as an unwanted child to become a student at Hogwarts, an English boarding school for wizards. There, he meets several friends who become his closest allies and help him discover the truth about his parents' mysterious deaths.

p.t: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets
p.d: The follow-up to "Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone" finds young wizard Harry Potter and his friends, Ron and Hermione, facing new challenges during their second year at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry as they try to discover a dark force that is terrorizing the school.
In order to save his home, an ogre along with a donkey makes a deal with a mean lord to rescue a beautiful princess.

After returning from their honeymoon and showing home movies to their friends, Shrek and Fiona learn that her parents have heard that she has married her true love and wish to invite him to their kingdom, called Far Far Away. The catch is: Fiona's parents are unaware of the curse that struck their daughter and have assumed she married Prince Charming, not a 700-pound ogre with horrible hygiene and a talking donkey pal.

p.t: Shrek the Third: Plus Bonus Content
p.d: Shrek embarks on another whirlwind adventure with Donkey and Puss in Boots to find the rightful heir to the throne. Meet the magical misguided Merlin, an awkward Arthur and a powerful posse of princesses in a tale where everyone lives happily ever laughter.

Long-settled into married life and fully domesticated, Shrek begins to long for the days when he felt like a real ogre. Duped into signing a contract with devious Rumpelstiltskin, he finds himself in an alternate version of Far Far Away, where ogres are hunted, Rumpelstiltskin rules, and he and Fiona have never met. Shrek must find a way out of the contract to restore his world and reclaim his true love.

After saving a newborn infant from assassins, carrot-crunching gunman Mr. Smith (Clive Owen) teams up with a prostitute named DQ (Monica Bellucci) to protect the baby from further attacks. With hit man Hertz (Paul Giamatti) hot on their trail, Smith and DQ uncover a dying senator's plot to harvest bone marrow from babies just like the one in their arms.

Matt is sentenced to life imprisonment and hard labor for shooting a fugitive.
A preacher (David Wayne) from the East wants to build a church to be shared by Indians and townspeople.
A wild stallion ruins the dreams of two broncobusters intent on trying to raise money for a Montana ranch.
A Basque youth (Robert Urich) is shunned for refusing to prove his manhood by fighting his father (Nehemiah Persoff).
Matt resigns after he is forced to kill a prisoner who was trying to save the marshal's life.
Thelma Lou and Barney play matchmaker for Andy and Karen, Thelma Lou's attractive cousin. However, Barney slips up, making Karen think that Andy is as crude as Barney makes him out to be.
Aunt Bee hires Mr Wheeler, an itinerant handyman, to help around the Taylor home. She has taken a liking to him, but Andy discovers that he is actually a freeloader.
Andy accepts a friend's offer to join an exclusive club and brings along Barney, who makes a fool of himself by putting on airs. Andy soon learns that only he has been selected for membership.
Andy, Barney and Opie substitute Aunt Bee's terrible homemade pickles with store-bought ones to avoid eating hers. Their plan backfires when Aunt Bee decides to enter them in the county fair.
A trial run as sheriff of Mayberry convinces Barney that he is not ready for a similar job in a nearby town.
Andy and Barney help Jeff, a farmer visiting Mayberry, search for a bride by cleaning him up and teaching him proper etiquette. Unfortunately for Barney, Jeff chooses Thelma Lou as his wife.
The family becomes concerned when a depressed Robert joins an organization that may actually be a cult.
An argument over housework leads Ray and Debra to a marriage counselor, but their session is far from therapeutic.
Ally's teacher invites Ray to address the curriculum review board after he comments that the kids have too much work to do.
Raymond writes a sample eulogy for Frank that ends up in the wrong hands.

p.t: Fatal Attraction: I'd Kill To Be You
p.d: At Fitzgerald High School in Michigan, a stabbing between two students sends shockwaves through the community; as investigators race to find a reason for the attack, they zero in on a friendship warped by jealousy and betrayal.

p.t: Fatal Attraction: I'd Kill To Be You
p.d: At sixteen, Shannon Braithwaite has it all, grades, looks, and a loving family; but her cousin's troubled life couldn't be more different. When family steps in to get her life on track, a jealous rage leaves one girl dead, and the other on the run.
Alyssa's teenage pregnancy sparks a family feud; Tiana battles with a man who pulls her into the darkness.
Amanda protects her dangerous love risking her children; April lights her life on fire to keep her baby and her man.
Christa Pike follows her man into the heart of darkness; Selena bits the hand of the man that feeds her.
Dwayne's friend comes for a visit and tries to convince him to transfer.
Whitley misconstrues Dwayne's beautiful poetry about mathematics as verses intended for her.
Whitley deals with a sales clerk's (Peggy Walton-Walker) racism in her own way, succeeding only in complicating the situation.
A visit by Clair Huxtable (Phylicia Rashad) prompts the students to think about their career goals.
Vanessa gets a chance to talk to the cutest boy at school at her first Halloween party.
Cliff gives Denise some pointers as she prepares to buy her first car.
Rudy becomes the star of a youth football team, but Cliff is worried about safety.
Clair's sister becomes engaged; Cliff struggles to beat his father-in-law (Joe Williams) at chess.
Denise's friend seeks medical advice from Cliff about a problem she is keeping from her parents.
Clair is determined not to let a broken toe interfere with her personal or professional life.
Moda, artesanía, diseño, belleza, cocina y arte de vivir; los mejores momentos de "Tendance XXI".

El presentador André Manoukian visita los castillos más bellos de la región Centro-Val de Loire. Grandes o pequeños, antiguos o modernos, famosos o desconocidos, cada uno de estos hitos del patrimonio francés cuenta su propia historia.
Inspirada en la vida de Magloire, nacido de madre togolesa y criado por una madre francesa, esta serie documental conoce a personas que han ido a instalarse a Francia en busca de un futuro mejor.

Tras 17 años de ausencia, Claire regresa a su ciudad natal en Montpellier con su hijo de 16 años, Théo. Ella huyó de su pasado y de sus padres después del suicidio de su hermana y vivió sola con su hijo en África, donde trabajó como enfermera.
La actualidad internacional descifrada por el mundo francófono de la mano de Mohamed Kaci y Clémentine Pawlotsky.
Una crónica sobre el idioma francés, sus curiosidades, su actualidad y sus acentos.

p.t: Back to the Future Part III
p.d: Marty McFly travels to the American Wild West of 1885 in a desperate bid to save Doc Brown from becoming another victim of a black-hatted gunslinger.
A couples' therapist is found drowned at sea off the coast of her exclusive retreat, and Mervin gets more than he bargained for when he tracks down his wayward brother.

Pioneering documentary maker Philomena Cunk returns with her most ambitious quest to date, venturing right up the universe and everything to examine life and existence in an attempt to find out the point of it all.

Kurtan is focusing his attentions on the annual village scarecrow festival, a key event in the village calendar that can both unite and divide the community. Tensions run high when his chances of winning the competition are compromised by being given a less than ideal plot to display his scarecrow.
When Kerry's neighbour Mandy Harris starts a tattoo business, Kerry is delighted to be one of her first customers. Meanwhile, Kurtan fixates on trying to track down a long-lost school friend.
Kerry and Kurtan await the release of their uncle, Steve 'Nugget' Nuggins, who they believe was wrongfully imprisoned for 'having a laugh'.

Unemployment remains high for young people in rural communities, so Kerry and Kurtan attend a talk at the village hall with a businesswoman who runs what may or may not be a pyramid scheme. Kerry is inspired and starts a career as a door-to-door saleswoman.

Relationships remain at the heart of rural life. We probe the fallout when Kerry's father, Martin, is accused of being a peeping tom. Meanwhile, Kurtan romantically pursues a girl who has just moved into the village but finds he has a rival for her affections.
Kerry and Kurtan explore the possibility of moving away from their village. Kurtan receives the exciting news that he could go to college to study for a GNVQ, news that Kerry is devastated by.

Jeremy Clarkson, Richard Hammond and James May visit Spain, with Clarkson in a McLaren 12C Spider, Hammond driving a Ferrari 458 Spider and May using an Audi R8 V10 Spyder. Also in this show, 'Sherlock' and 'Star Trek' actor Benedict Cumberbatch is the star in the Reasonably Priced Car.

The Great British Sewing Bee does its bit for the planet with Reduce, Reuse and Recycle week. Host Sara Pascoe invites the nine remaining home sewers to create a quilted patchwork jacket from a load of old scraps from past Sewing Bees. Next, in the Transformation Challenge, the sewers breathe new life into boring old coats by completely deconstructing them and refashioning them into brand new stylish outerwear.

Stephen Watson brings you all the action from the Boris Paichadze National Stadium in Tbilisi as Northern Ireland begin their UEFA Nations League campaign. Michael O'Neill's side open their League B campaign with a testing trip to Georgia. With Hungary and Ukraine also lying in wait, a win in Tiblisi would provide Northern Ireland with early momentum in the race for promotion. Can Northern Ireland make the perfect start?

Claire und Phil wollen ihrer Tochter Haley beim Umzug ins College helfen. Doch dabei bringen sie das Mädchen immer wieder in peinliche Situationen. Phil kommt Haleys neuer Zimmergenossin gefährlich nahe, da er sie mit Claire verwechselt hat. Cameron fällt es schwer, seine Tochter Lily in der Vorschule zurückzulassen.

Luke weiß nicht, wie er seinem Vater mitteilen soll, dass er das Interesse an der Zauberei verloren hat. Als dieser das zufällig mitbekommt, ist er sehr enttäuscht. Am Ende gelingt es ihnen jedoch, einen Kompromiss zu finden.

Malcolm traut sich und fragt Angela, ob sie mit ihm zum Frühjahrsball gehen will. Doch zunächst muss er sich der Familie nähern, was auch sehr gut klappt. Doch nach einer Weile wird Malcolm das Ganze zu viel und er macht Schluss.

Nachdem Lois und Hal Reese aus der Wohnung schmeißen, zieht Reese in seine eigene Wohnung. Zunächst scheint Reese mit der Situation sehr gut klar zu kommen, bis Lois und Hal erfahren, dass er sich hoch verschuldet hat.

Jay lädt seinen Cousin Sunil zum St. Patrick's Day ein, sehr zum Ärger von Hetty. Überraschend erwachen ihre Geisterkräfte durch die Situation. Hetty kann ihre neuen Fähigkeiten nicht kontrollieren und verursacht unbeabsichtigt Chaos im ganzen Haus.

Bastian stellt sich krank, um nicht mit Anke Engelke den Deutschen Fernsehpreis moderieren zu müssen. Jemand macht Fotos von ihm, als er in der Öffentlichkeit einen Schwächeanfall vortäuscht und schon brodelt die Gerüchteküche.
Die Crew untersucht, ob das Universum eine Simulation ist.

Der Lieferjunge Fry wird aus Versehen eingefroren und wacht 1.000 Jahre später in Neu-New York wieder auf. Alles hat sich verändert und Fry hat Probleme, sich auf die neuen Umstände einzustellen. Doch er findet schnell Freunde, die ihm helfen.

Stan nimmt an einem Essay-Wettbewerb teil, um seinen großen Helden George W. Bush zu einem Besuch bei der Familie Smith zu bewegen. Als der Präsident dann tatsächlich auftaucht, stehen die Zeichen auf Sturm. Haylie versucht sogleich, dem Präsidenten seine tiefe Schuld für den Irak-Krieg zu verdeutlichen, während Steve und Roger behaupten, Osama bin Laden gefunden zu haben.

Da Stan Zweifel an seiner körperlichen Fitness hegt, die ein Muss für die Ausführung seines Jobs ist, versucht er, sich durch eine alte Leidenschaft ein zweites Standbein aufzubauen. Er will in den Vertrieb von Teddybären einsteigen.
Als E-Bikes in South America Einzug halten, erobern die Jungs die Straßen im Sturm. Die Eltern von South America erkennen ihre Stadt kaum noch wieder.
Rick lädt eine wichtige Person zum Dinner ein, und Morty muss sich um den Wein kümmern.

Als einer von Ricks Deals misslingt, müssen er und Morty auf Ricks Notfallplan zurückgreifen: Die beiden verstecken sich in einem präparierten Säurefass. Zurück zu Hause reicht es Morty. Er will, dass auch seine Vorschläge ernst genommen werden.
Die Schauspielerin Merritt Wever ist bei Desi Lydic zu Gast und wird zu ihrem Film interviewt.
Judi Love präsentiert die brillanten Comedians Joshua Bethania, Michael Odewale, Jin Hao Li, Kyrah Gray und Sunil Patel sowie Hauptact Pierre Novellie.

When Monica's parents clear out her old room to install a gym, they unearth an old video of her and Rachel's first prom night. It's obvious from this that Ross is in love with Rachel and, having told him it will never happen, Rachel changes her mind. Elsewhere, Joey gives Chandler a hideous bracelet as a token of his friendship and is mortally offended to hear Chandler saying how terrible it is.

Among the guests at Monica's party is a handsome and sophisticated doctor, but the only problem is that he's old enough to be her father. Meanwhile, Joey buys a big screen TV and two reclining leather armchairs with the money from his `Days of Our Lives' contract.

Everyone at Monica's dad's birthday party finds it amusing that their middle-aged friend, eye-doctor Richard Burke, is dating a woman in her 20s - until Monica's parents learn that it is their daughter. Meanwhile, Chandler and Joey row over a dirty spoon. Is the flat still big enough for both of them?
With Joey in his new flat, Chandler gets a troublesome new flatmate. Phoebe makes a video for 'Smelly Cat' and Ross and Monica find it nearly impossible to live together.
Joey's remarks to a fan magazine could cause him to lose his job playing Dr Ramoray on a daytime television drama, and Chandler's new flatmate Eddie becomes too annoying to cope with.
Chandler wants his annoying new roommate to move out, Joey is forced to face some exorbitant bills, and the girls learn from a book about personal empowerment.
Monica's new boyfriend impresses Chandler and Joey, Phoebe finds out what she missed as a child, and Rachel resents the fact that Ross is planning the rest of their lives together.

Monica is broke and decides to gamble on the stock market, and Chandler and Ross run into a couple of bullies in Central Park. Meanwhile, Rachel and Joey help Phoebe locate her father, but a vicious dog prevents Phoebe from finally meeting him. After accidentally injuring the dog with her car, Phoebe gets to know her father's second wife whom she never knew about and another long-lost family member.

Monica decides to hold a surprise birthday for Rachel, but everything goes wrong when Rachel's estranged parents turn up unexpectedly. The party then splits into two factions: a dreary gathering in Monica's flat, and a college-style drunken party at Chandler and Joey's flat.

Phoebe's submariner boyfriend visits New York on leave from the Navy. Unfortunately, Phoebe catches chicken pox at baby Ben's first birthday party. Meanwhile, when Monica realises that Richard has no real neuroses, she worries that she is too strange for him.

When Rachel serves as a bridesmaid at the wedding of her ex-fiancé Barry and her friend Mindy, she relives the nightmare of her own failed wedding day. Meanwhile, Chandler becomes enamoured with a woman he meets on the Internet, but is surprised when he finally meets her.

Stacey Dooley bravely hands over her phone in Send to All, Olly Murs performs his single 'Dancing On Cars', there's a rude awakening for comedian Alexander Armstrong in the Midnight Game Show, and there's a mind-blowing duet from our young Unexpected Stars of the Show.
Mr Bean goes back to school where he takes part in a science demonstration, attends an art class and learns the finer points of judo.
Mr Bean goes to the launderette where he loses his trousers once again. He then plays a round of mini golf but has trouble keeping his ball on the green.

p.t: Whose Line Is It Anyway? USA [NEW]
p.d: Aisha and the comedians are joined by guest star Danielle Panabaker, and guest comic Gary Anthony Williams.
When Debra accuses Ray of still not being able to pick up on her 'not in the mood' signals, they fondly recall the first night they spent together.
Depressed that Marie and Debra can't seem to resolve their differences, Robert decides to join a support group that the family believes is a cult.

Debra decides she and Ray should go to see a marriage counsellor. Although Ray is completely against the idea, he quickly changes his attitude when they meet the therapist, Pamela, who instantly takes a liking to him.
Charlie asks Caroline out to build her confidence.
Joanna's burgeoning love life unsettles Charlie.
When Sabrina throws Hilda a surprise party for her 650th birthday, Hilda becomes depressed that she doesn't have a family yet.
Zelda (Beth Broderick) becomes a party animal after moving in with Sabrina (Melissa Joan Hart) and her college roommates.
Sabrina (Melissa Joan Hart) agrees to a double date on Valentine's Day with Josh and Morgan (David Lascher, Elisa Donovan).
Sabrina tries to convince the witching school Witchright Hall to admit her rebellious cousin (Emily Hart).
Rhod Gilbert is joined by Rachel Riley, Ahir Shah and Iain Stirling as they travel back in time. Discover who smashed a stained-glass window and who can play Nirvana on the saxophone.
Rachel accidentally lets Ross's pet monkey escape, and the friends form a search party. She is then horrified to learn that her former best friend is engaged to marry her ex-fiancé.

Rachel gets back together with her ex-fiancé Barry, even though he's engaged to her best friend Mindy. Meanwhile, Chandler agonises over a wonderful woman who fails to call him after their first date.
Someone is pretending to be Monica, using her credit card numbers and having the sort of fun that Monica wishes she could have.
Monica discovers that she's developed a highly mature approach to her latest love affair, and Ross finds out that he's being mistaken for a male prostitute.
The side-splitting grand finale of Lee Evans' 100 date sell-out UK tour at the Edinburgh Playhouse.
When a man is found burnt to death in his home workshop, his wife is charged with murder. However, the ensuing arson investigation points in a very different direction.

A judge apologises to the children of a murdered woman for not being able to give their mother's killer a harsher sentence; a woman being sent to jail for violating her probation accidentally curses at the judge before leaving her virtual hearing.

p.t: Rick Stein From Venice to Istanbul
p.d: Rick Stein's gastronomic journey from Venice to Istanbul brings him to northern Greece. In Ioannina, Rick tastes veal stifado and kotopita. Later, Rick travels to Messolonghi to follow in the footsteps of Lord Byron.

p.t: Rick Stein From Venice to Istanbul
p.d: Continuing his journey from Venice to Istanbul, Rick Stein arrives in the Greek Peloponnese and samples memorable dishes like rooster stew hilopites with mizithra cheese and the best home-made moussaka he's ever had. In his Symi island kitchen he cooks galaktoboureko, Greece's all-time favourite dessert.

Paul and Bob visit south west France to fish the River Lot, with some new species in their sights, including black bass, vandoise, and grass carp. Paul tries to concentrate on the fishing but Bob, as ever, wants to reminisce and chat.

Ein ungewöhnlicher Kunde im Pfandhaus Offenburg: Ein Mann möchte seinen Rasentrimmer beleihen, um schnell an Geld zu kommen. Für den Pfandleiher beginnt nun die knifflige Schätzung des Gartengeräts. Kann der Kunde auf einen guten Deal hoffen?

Außentermin in Sachsen: Zwei Schwestern legen in Weißig nach dem Tod ihrer Mutter Kisten voller Uhren, Ferngläser, Schmuck und Briefmarken bereit. Doch was sind die Erinnerungsstücke tatsächlich wert?

Erste Nachforschungen in Polen ergeben, dass im Boden etwas ganz Großes steckt. Damit ist aber noch nicht erwiesen, dass es sich um einen Panzer aus dem Zweiten Weltkrieg handelt. Michael Manousakis und seine Truppe sind trotzdem Feuer und Flamme.

Mithilfe einer selbst gebastelten Spezialkonstruktion und einem Bagger soll der Panzer in Polen geborgen werden. Zusammen mit Schweißgerät und Bolzen rücken zwei Dutzend Helfer im Sumpfgebiet an und schlagen dort ihre Zelte auf.

Die Sendung informiert über alle wichtigen Neuigkeiten aus der Welt. Die Zuschauer bekommen so einen Überblick über den aktuellen Stand verschiedenster Themen wie Gesellschaft, Kultur, Politik, Sport, Wirtschaft und Zeitgeschehen.

Auf der anderen Seite des Flusses streifen Wildtiere umher, die für Frank und Teal als Nahrung dienen könnten. Doch so weit können sie mit ihrem Bogen nicht schießen. Schwimmen ist auch keine Option, denn in dem Gewässer tummeln sich hungrige Krokodile. Um das Jagdgebiet zu erreichen, müsste das Duo eine Brücke bauen. Dafür erhielten sie obendrein 100 Punkte, mit denen sie im Ranking aufsteigen könnten. Für den nächsten Survival-Test sollen die Teams in Südafrika außerdem eine Fackel herstellen.

Twelve Naked and Afraid stars and rising stars take on a scorched, apocalyptic landscape where humans have tried -- and failed -- to survive. The veterans must repurpose the wreckage of a ghost town, cemetery, junkyard, and mine to make.

Zwölf Kandidaten müssen sich in Gruppen durch die Savanne Kolumbiens kämpfen, in der die Temperaturen auf bis zu 50 Grad steigen können. Ohne Ausrüstung, Kleidung und Nahrung müssen sie dort ganze 40 Tage und Nächte überleben.

Der ehemalige Soldat Hakim muss die Survival-Challenge frühzeitig beenden, weil sein Körper nicht mehr mitspielt. Zu sehr leidet er unter den starken Krämpfen. Auch die übrigen Kandidaten haben mit der glühenden Hitze im Orinoko-Becken zu kämpfen.

Am Düsseldorfer Hauptbahnhof versuchen zwei Bundespolizisten, einen renitenten Fahrgast ohne Ticket zur Feststellung seiner Personalien zu bewegen. Ein weiterer Einsatz aufgrund eines Zugausfalls sorgt für zusätzliche Anspannung.

Die Bundespolizei sucht eine junge Ausreißerin. Zudem gibt es in Düsseldorf Streit um ein Gepäckstück und ein Reisender wird vom Flughafen verwiesen. Außerdem helfen Beamte in Berlin einem Obdachlosen. Erleben Sie den harten Alltag der Polizei!

Während Rettungsschwimmer Harrison versucht, ein Geschwisterpaar aus dem Wasser zu retten, drücken sie ihn unter Wasser. Die vermeintliche Panikattacke der Geschwister gerät außer Kontroller, die sich nur wenige Meter vom Ufer aus entfernt abspielt.

Hauke und sein Team fahren an der A7 bei Hildesheim schwere Geschütze auf, denn dort arbeiten sechs Bagger beim Abriss einer Brücke parallel unter Hochdruck. In Köln muss es ebenfalls schnell gehen, um die Anwohner nicht unnötig lange zu belästigen.

The Raneys attempt to rescue a family descended from rock'n'roll royalty by reclaiming their homestead from the jungle on Kauai. But when a dangerous flash flood strikes, the Raneys find themselves on the wrong side of the river and out of time.

The Cheals hit a massive pocket of plate-sized opal in their open cut mine. Lee and Roger attempt to find enough opal to purchase a water saving trommel. And brutal Outback temperatures cripple Cozza with severe heat stroke.
Rod, Sam and Ben try to find enough opal for Les's retirement before the end of the season. Cody escapes death in a deep shaft.
The Gold Devils have their sights set on a record-breaking total and a gold drought leads to one member of the Poseidon Crew questioning his future.
The Gold Devils move their multi-million-dollar operation in search of big gold. New team Vince, Bibi and Murray break ground on their dream lease.

After a giant suspension bridge begins to violently rock, it suddenly collapses, marking one of the most iconic engineering disasters of all time. Using the latest science, experts reveal what went so wrong at the Tacoma Narrows bridge.

In 1964, ITV asked a group of the oldest people in Britain about the past. The people in it had been born into Queen Victoria's imperial Britain. The film hears them talking about work, money, loneliness, health and their hopes in 1965.

In 1964, ITV broadcast a film about fourteen seven-year-olds. It became the longest running documentary series ever. Those children are now seventy. 7 Up set out to prove that Britain was divided by the class system - that these children's futures had been decided by the street they were born on. The production team had three weeks to find them. They went to some of the poorest parts of the country and some of the most privileged, and came back with ten boys and four girls. The series became one of British television's most remarkable social experiments, the cameras dipping into their lives every seven years. Children from different parts of the class system who have now become friends. This special programme looks at the year 7 Up was made, the idea behind it, and what they hoped for in a Britain about to change around them.

Pat is 77 years old and searching for the son she placed for adoption when she was just 15. A few years after his adoption, Pat discovered she couldn't have any more children naturally. Now she longs to see her only son again to tell him she has always loved him. Jake has not seen his two paternal siblings Tom and Katie since he was a baby; they seemingly vanished off the face of the earth.

In 1964, ITV asked a group of the oldest people in Britain about the past. The people in it had been born into Queen Victoria's imperial Britain. The film hears them talking about work, money, loneliness, health and their hopes in 1965.

In 1964, ITV broadcast a film about fourteen seven-year-olds. It became the longest running documentary series ever. Those children are now seventy. 7 Up set out to prove that Britain was divided by the class system - that these children's futures had been decided by the street they were born on. The production team had three weeks to find them. They went to some of the poorest parts of the country and some of the most privileged, and came back with ten boys and four girls. The series became one of British television's most remarkable social experiments, the cameras dipping into their lives every seven years. Children from different parts of the class system who have now become friends. This special programme looks at the year 7 Up was made, the idea behind it, and what they hoped for in a Britain about to change around them.

Emmerdale is one of Britain's best-loved and highly viewed long-running drama soaps - set in the heart of the beautiful countryside of the Yorkshire Dales, this realistic and down-to-earth drama superbly chronicles the joys and the heartbreaks of a tightly knit countryside community.
David claims to be a new man after his time away and remains calm as he learns of Joe's arrangements. Peter's jealousy of Michelle's friendship with Luke threatens his sobriety.
Tempers fray as the Platts celebrate Easter, and amid the chaos David offers Tina a gift. Kevin challenges Tyrone to a race and Ken considers attending Martha's performance.
Ashfordly station is targeted by crooks stealing freight wagons with a rogue locomotive. Peggy prepares to rake in the profits when she fixes the local bowls tournament.

Two small girls provide crucial information when they stumble across a sinister scam whilst playing on the moors. Peggy's poker-playing antics force Blaketon to take drastic action. Could a night out lead to love for Rob?

Martin rubs up against the new herbalist and Penhale, Louisa and James are all interested in Janice's new pedicure fish. Martin's ex-flame invites him to speak as keynote speaker at Imperial College, and Ruth is back from Mexico with more than maracas.

With the wedding approaching there is excitement in the air. Spanish flu reaches Downton and a desperate Thomas looks for a way to re-establish himself. Ethel faces a dilemma when the Bryants return with a heartbreaking proposition. A decisive Anna forces Bates to think about their future.
The discovery of slaves turns a murder inquiry into a huge, multi-agency investigation, which threatens to topple Gill. But Scott and Bailey are determined to protect Gill's prodigious reputation.

p.d: The team examines the extent to which a European war became a global conflict, and how Britain's global position changed irrevocably as the country was quickly and efficiently brought to its knees.

A look at the longest serving infantry division in the US Army, who fought in every major campaign in Western Europe during World War II, in which American forces were engaged. Their unit badge is simply, `1'.

It is high summer in the polar regions, and the sun never sets. Vast hordes of summer visitors cram a lifetime of drama into one long, magical day; they must feed, fight and rear their young in this brief window of plenty. Summer is a tough time for the polar bear family, as their ice world melts away and the cubs take their first swimming lesson.
It's Robbie's toughest trip yet as he battles through water weed on the Bradley Arm and gets stuck in silt on the Ridgacre Branch.
Robbie encounters a leaky lock pound on the Perry Barr Flight and gets marooned in the mud before travelling under Spaghetti Junction in Birmingham.
Derek picks up four tasty vehicles from a farm in Shropshire. Among them are a 1937 Austin Seven van and a Triumph TR2 from the mid-1950s.

Paul and his son Charlie head to Leicestershire to collect a vintage Albion truck. For Tom Harrison, the truck has been a part of his family for over half a century. Both fall for the Albion's charms and its rare travelling hardware shop memorabilia.
Derek rubs shoulders with pop music royalty when he picks up a classic Morgan sports car. A World War Two ambulance arrives at Thornton le Dale and a Ford Model T needs a new home.

p.t: How To Catch A Serial Killer
p.d: Spanning more than a decade, multiple murders, two much-publicised trials and one irreparably damaged career, it is a story of the dogged pursuit of a serial-killer. The pursuit of Christopher Halliwell by Detective Steve Fulcher has been one of the biggest crime stories in recent years, captivating the public's attention.
While Button House is being fumigated for woodworm, Alison and Mike decide to save some money and camp in the grounds, sending the ghosts' routines off kilter.

Alison has invited Lucy to come to Button House for a sleepover, but after a worrying meeting with the solicitor, Alison must work out if Lucy is really who she says she is. The Captain insists on utilising his skills in surveillance to help Alison find out the truth. After an emailing prank by Julian gets out of hand, Mike has some awkward explaining to do to his boss, which Julian and Robin are gleeful to have front row seats for.
When the ghosts try to sabotage Alison's makeshift therapy session for Kitty, they unwittingly face their own demons. Meanwhile, Mike's desire to see the ghosts yields surprising results.

Susan's feathers are ruffled when Nick lands the plum part of Jesus in an amateur theatrical production, leaving Susan to play the rather less demanding part of Shepherd Number Two. Ben, meanwhile, has an extremely painful toothache to contend with, and is wary of entrusting his dental needs to any other dentist.

p.d: Simon O'Brien and Max McMurdo head for Crewe to meet rock and roller Billy, who lives in a house that is frozen in time in the 1950s.
Angus helps an army veteran shift a mountain of Lego to raise money for his daughter, and a trip to London unearths exquisite Victorian jewellery.

Angus helps a widow sell three generations of memories, including wartime treasures and a rare photo of magician Houdini, while a couple in Essex sell their sci-fi stash to fund a wedding 26 years in the making.

Captain Izzie Balmer and First Mate Charlie Ross are sailing to the Isle of Wight for their final leg of this Road Trip. Charlie rips his trousers while on horseback, and Izzie ditches the classic car in favour of a speedboat.
Angus helps clear a family home, packed with museum pieces. And a retired teacher parts with Sheffield steel, French glass and a seafarer's desk.
Three highly sentimental heirlooms are thrown a lifeline, including an old fishing reel and a quirky leather footstool shaped like a pig.

A 1960s record player and a flamboyant pair of 1970s boots are given a new lease of life. Plus, a painting by artist Helene de Beauvoir, sister of French philosopher Simone de Beauvoir, is lovingly restored.
How do they build life rafts that can hold 150 people, how can mind control techniques help golfers improve their shots, and how do they produce millions of celebratory stamps?
How do they produce tequila from cactus plants in Mexico, how does New York City run on steam, and how do they make soft ice cream?
How do stuntmen survive a bad day at work, how do they mine precious amber gemstones, and how do they build Seabreacher watercraft that move like dolphins?
How is New York supplied with the finest steaks, how do they produce the ultimate surround sound home cinema systems, and how do they make and test tennis balls?
The boys stop at a salvage yard which Drew describes as the best in the country. They find a pair of beautifully crafted sundials and an overthrow believed to be from Belvoir Castle.
Drew and Tee explore a restored castle in the Scottish Lowlands and then up to the Scottish capital of Edinburgh, once known as the Athens of the North, for a bit of antique shopping.
Sculptor, Nick Elphick is tasked with having to attempt to recreate the missing parts of a vintage deer skeleton. Meanwhile, furniture restorer, Steve Norman rebuilds a rosewood sofa.
Plastic moulds, filing cabinets and blown glass: more everyday items are put under the microscope to discover how they're made.
Stephanie is a gifted stage performer and much-loved teacher; behind closed doors, resentment and envy fester in her marriage, leading to a shocking 911 call.
Ramon Sosa is a father of three who runs a successful boxing gym in Texas; he feels like the luckiest man alive until someone marks him for murder.

Teenager Cindy Taylor's world is shattered by the sudden death of her father, while police say he died of a heart attack, Taylor will discover the cause of her father's death is just one of the deadly secrets her mother had been hiding from her.
A woman's life is in the balance after she escapes years of coercive control and domestic abuse. And the tragic case of 16-year-old Thomas Edwards, who was killed following a hit-and-run accident.
Christian Aguilar mysteriously vanishes from his university campus. Police are stumped, until some CCTV footage leads the case in a shocking new direction.
In 2014, Kimberly Robertson's battered body is found on a pavement after a date with her boyfriend. Can CCTV footage help detectives identify her killer?
When Aziza Murphy ends a relationship with a man she meets online, he launches a relentless stalking campaign that takes her job, safety and peace.
Elizabeth investigates the troubling case of Kate Ranta, a military wife who found herself in an abusive relationship and battling all the systems that protect abusers.
In 2012, local DJ Ervin Holton is shot dead on his friend's porch. With no witnesses, police turn to the security cameras opposite for evidence.
Hiding a body can be difficult. It's sometimes easier to obscure or disguise the circumstances of the death, or turning murder into suicide.
In 2014, Jessica Padgett disappears. Surveillance cameras show her driving into a car park and walking down an alley, never to return. What happened to her?
In 2011, Patty Ayala is murdered at the Burger King where she works. Police turn to surveillance video - and see a brutal killer emerging from the shadows.

CNN's chief Washington correspondent, Jake Tapper, hosts this hour-long weekday afternoon program, which covers all the day's top stories from around the country and the world, headlines that span politics, money, sports and popular culture. `The Lead' works to ensure that viewers are caught up on the stories that matter, often highlighting news that may have been overlooked. Prior to joining CNN, Tapper served as senior White House correspondent at ABC News.

It's Erin Burnett's turn to step out front and try to maintain a viable viewer presence for CNN in the weekday news arena. But the former CNBC anchor won't worry about ratings for her hourlong general news program, comparing that burden to "death." Instead, she'll concern herself with translating world events into relevant information for viewers, paying close attention to such topics as the Middle East and women's issues. "I want people to say that our show is smart. I want our show to be authentic", Burnett says in a promo. "I want our show to have courage". Left unsaid, of course, is that she wants her show to have a big audience, too.

Un incendio coarta los sueños de Rocío, una joven estudiante con un novio cariñoso, Gabino, ya que pierde su casa, su dinero, su futuro y su sueño.
Franco abandona su pasión por la música para darle una estabilidad a su familia. No obstante, harto de su rutina, decide seguir con sus sueños, pero su familia no lo toma muy bien.

A veces los problemas del día a día pueden solucionarse con un poco de ayuda milagrosa. Esta exitosa serie muestra casos de la vida real en los cuales los protagonistas se enfrentan a grandes encrucijadas o a situaciones terribles, y no les queda más remedio que pedir un milagro. Es allí cuando la fe se pone a prueba y se vuelve poderosa, pues demuestra que de la situación más terrible se puede salir. Pensado para quienes creen que la fe mueve montañas, esta conmovedora serie muestra la manera en la que los protagonistas se encomiendan a la Virgen Morena buscando resolver sus dificultades.

La historia de Yolanda, una hermosa e inteligente reclusa, quien en la cárcel se convierte en la amante de uno de los narcotraficantes más importante del país, Benedictino García, conocido como "El Centauro". Esta relación le da a Yolanda mucho poder, pero también es su pesadilla cuando sale en libertad.
Una condena injusta cambia la vida de Alejandro Gaitán y lo separa de la mujer que ama, Mariana Zambrano. En prisión, se convierte en otra persona y regresa, 17 años más tarde, para vengarse.
Patricia y su hermano sufrieron mucho en su infancia, y ya no lo pueden soportar.

Juan Carlos Caballero, un ejecutivo importante de una empresa turística, que solía ser mujeriego, cae en las redes del amor y dos sucesos contrarios lo obligan a huir. Luego, él regresa asumiendo la personalidad de una mujer, Eva, con el fin de conquistar a la mujer que ama, Helena Moreno, una madre soltera, trabajadora y visionaria y de desenmascarar a los culpables causantes de su huida, quienes lo desacreditaron injustamente, al ser acusado de un fraude financiero y de haberle robado el proyecto turístico a Helena. En su nueva personalidad, él está cerca de Helena pero a la vez nunca ha estado tan lejos, las situaciones difíciles que se le presentan al tener que imitar al género opuesto no son tan complicadas como el evitar que sus sentimientos por Helena sean tan evidentes que lo delaten. Una adaptación de la telenovela colombiana "En los Tacones de Eva".

Ellison Oswald es un escritor de crímenes reales que está en una mala racha: no ha tenido éxito en más de diez años y está desesperado. Sin embargo, cuando unas imágenes antiguas y otras pistas apuntan a una presencia sobrenatural, Ellison descubre que vivir en esa casa podría poner en peligro a los suyos.
